Amal: quick intake — spotted EPSS spike for CVE-2026-1024 (libcrypto-xyz). CVSS 7.5, vendor patch available. No PoC in advisory. tagging owners @Ruth @Jordan :eyes:
Jordan: I'll look into exploitability and triage PoC status. If PoC exists -> escalate to P1. Do we need to rotate KMS keys preemptively?
Amal: quick scan: EPSS 0.08 and trending; NVD/ExploitDB show no PoC right now. Services depending on this crate:
```
$ rg "libcrypto-xyz" --line-number services/ | sort
services/token-signer/src/Cargo.toml:12
services/data-ingest-gateway/cargo.lock:201
services/edge-parser/Cargo.toml:34
```
Ruth: token-signer uses our KMS via HSM proxy (aws-kms). If vuln enables cert/key extraction it's high impact, but extraction path looks non-trivial. I'll run a full dependency graph and open a tracking ticket. Recommend enabling detailed KMS audit logs for the token-signer canary.
sec-bot: [automated scan] Found libcrypto-xyz v1.2.3 in 3 services. CVSS 7.5 EPSS 0.08. Suggested severity: High. Suggested owner: @Ruth.
Jordan: Proposed plan: 1) patch token-signer + data-ingest -> libcrypto-xyz v1.2.5 (no API breaks), 2) deploy canary with enhanced KMS audit logging + continuous checks for anomalous encrypt/decrypt ops for 48h, 3) if PoC is verified rotate signing keys in HSM, 4) run dependency-wide rebuild for edge-parser. Also need temporary RBAC change so devsec can read KMS audit logs (audit role TTL 72h) — objections? :thinking_face:
Amal: Sounds good. I'll coordinate the canary with oncall and the rollout window. If no PoC in 24h, move to medium priority. :thumbsup:
Ruth: On it. I'll open PRs for the patches + an IAM PR for temp role devsec/kms-audit-read (ttl=72h). Will post ticket/PR links here once created.
Jordan: thanks — I'll monitor exploit feeds and try to repro locally against a minimal harness.
oncall: acknowledged. I'll keep pager on for the canary window.
Amal: closing loop — please add any blockers or missing assets (e.g., reproducible build steps, KMS audit dashboard queries).
